finalText:
CHANGELOG.md now has a 4.2.0 entry. Two things worth your judgment call before you ship it:

1. **The 401/403 auth change** — I put it under Breaking since anyone matching on `403` for expired tokens will break, even though it reads like a bug fix (403 was arguably wrong). Move it to Fixed if you consider the old behavior unsupported/undocumented.
2. **Perf PRs excluded** — 4 merged perf PRs (metric write batching, avoiding a clone, skipping a JSON round-trip) shipped but had no concrete numbers attached, so I left them out rather than write a vague "faster" bullet. Say the word if you have benchmark numbers and want one added.

Everything else in the log is one line per distinct shipped behavior, deduped against the merged-PR sheet (not the raw commit log, which had a lot of same-titled fixes that never actually merged).
